stable_boundaries: AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, routing, fallback, retry, model-card management, and the base shared Dashboard schema.
The plugin adapts Volcengine request and media protocols; it does not maintain a second global model-capability database.
The user-facing Video truth remains the native per-model-card modalities selection. The precise UI path scopes it to the two plugin-owned Source types after a private dialog clone exists.

No shared-schema Video injection exists anymore. The native video option may only be added on concrete model-card objects of the two plugin-owned Source types, via the private dialog clone (asset bridge) or the live component instance (runtime bridge). Foreign dialogs must never receive it, and the create/update save boundary strips any forged value.
Future AstrBot-native Video support is host-owned and must not be deleted by plugin cleanup.
Request transport settings are not permanent model-capability facts.

Local video materialization must reject empty and oversized input before base64-encoding and bound any ffmpeg work with a timeout plus kill-on-cancel; remote http(s) URLs remain pass-through because their size is unknown locally.
CHANGELOG.md ships with the runtime package because AstrBot renders the post-update changelog popup from it; it stays byte-identical to the development changelog and must not carry secrets.

A changed shipped CHANGELOG.md is a changed runtime tree and therefore requires a strictly newer metadata version plus a validated release candidate; published runtime artifacts are never edited in place.

The 0.1.19+ rich per-model request fields, audio path, video quality modes, Agent Plan routing, migrations, and request override semantics are compatibility baseline behavior unless a separate validated change explicitly replaces them.
Development documentation, tests, evidence, and experiments stay outside the allow-list runtime package.
A passing gate proves only the object and layer named by that gate; real source-type differential, persistence, runtime behavior, and unload/release evidence remain distinct checks.
